headline: A shorter sidebar, tabbed sections, and a time range that follows you

highlights.title: Navigation
highlights.body: The sidebar is down to nine entries. Stats, Library and Automations are tabbed sections. Stats and Library share one time range picker (Library shows it to staff on every tab and to members on Genres; Automations has none), and the range stays across tabs and sidebar links. Violations sits under Automations with a pending count on the sidebar. Old URLs redirect.

highlights.title: People
highlights.body: Stats has a People tab that ranks everyone by plays, hours, data, transcode share, requests or last seen, with search and paging. Users is a management table with role and sign-in columns, and a Status column that links each pending count to Violations. A user page shows stats for the selected range against the prior range and the server average.

highlights.title: Music
highlights.body: Browse has a Music tab with an artist grid, and artist pages list albums with year and track count beside a Listeners panel. Overview has shelves for new albums and most played artists. Activity charts split plays into movies, shows and music. History and the Dashboard show listen time beside watch time, and tracks say played instead of watched. Storage lists each library's item count and size.

changes.text: sidebar drops to nine entries; Stats and Library share one time range, Automations is tabbed
Violations is a tab under Automations, and the sidebar shows the pending count
page headers are gone; the controls row (tabs, time range, filters) is the header on list pages and sections
People tab in Stats ranks every person by plays, hours, data, transcodes, requests or last seen
Users is a management table with role, sign-in and pending flags, and filters for each
user pages show range stats, prior-range and server-average comparisons, when, what and where cards, and tabs
the Top 3 podium is gone; the People table is the ranking, with no separate top-three section
Bandwidth, Devices and Requests link to People in place of their per-user tables
Genres tab shows library share beside play share, prior-range deltas, finished rate and never played
click a genre for a sheet with its viewers, top titles, hourly pattern and never-played titles
Genres has a media type control for movies, TV shows or artists that stays in the URL across Library tabs
music libraries sync albums with their own art and added date
Browse has a Music tab with an artist grid, and artist pages list albums, listeners and plays
Overview shelves for recently added albums and most played artists
Activity charts split plays into movies, shows and music
listen time shows beside watch time on History and the Dashboard when music was played
Storage lists every library with its item count and size
clicking an album on an artist page opens a sheet with its tracks, plays, listeners and listen time
Quality, Storage and Most Watched take custom date ranges
Most Watched, codec, resolution, binge and stale tables are translated
History's date range uses the same URL params as every other page
Storage, Watch, top content tables, badges and the error state are translated
session details, stream details, debug tabs, dialogs and chart empty states are translated
Quality and Browse use the shared media type control, and Library links carry the type
engagement tiers and the session sheet labels are translated
artist pages read their plays through a new index on the track-to-artist link
Bandwidth shows the top five people by data with a link to the full ranking
a member whose library limits change no longer sees the old cached genres for up to an hour
plays under 2 minutes that pass the watched threshold, like short tracks, count in stats and the v2 history API
a Library link carrying a media type no longer sends Browse back to Movies
music rows in History say played instead of watched, and today's plays count tracks
Storage's never-watched count now comes from the Stale query, and the Dead Weight list moved into the Stale card
stats rebuild in the background after updating and show the last 7 days until done; music play counts will go up
moved pages: /media is now /library and the /stats/users page is now /stats/people; old links redirect
the /api/v1/stats/users and /api/v1/stats/top-users API endpoints were removed; /api/v1/stats/people replaces them
the first scan after this update is a full scan so albums appear; items it finds are not announced as new
today's plays, sessions and active users count music on the Dashboard and the v1 /stats/today
background tasks no longer pile up after restarts; one sync or poster warm-up per server, resumed where it stopped
a Tautulli import interrupted by a restart continues from the last finished page
first boot after updating clears queued tasks once and queues one poster pass per server; syncs restart, imports stay
poster caching after library syncs can be turned off in Settings → Servers → Posters
a busy server no longer bounces you to the dashboard; you stay on the page, and signing in returns you to it
PAL SD shows as 576p in Now Playing and history; Normalize Resolutions under Jobs relabels older plays
